einzeiler: Analysis of the GOP midterm convention in Dallas and an interview with Steve Hilton.
kurzfassung: Jon and Dan break down the notable moments and speeches from the GOP midterm convention in Dallas. They discuss Donald Trump's conditional financial proposal and contributions from figures like JD Vance, Mike Rogers, Ted Cruz, and John Fetterman. Later, Lovett interviews Steve Hilton, the Republican nominee for California governor, about Trump and housing.
stichpunkte: Donald Trump's conditional $5,000 check proposal for American adults
JD Vance's preview of his presidential campaign
Mike Rogers and Ted Cruz addressing the 25th anniversary of 9/11
Democratic Senator John Fetterman's surprise video appearance
Lovett's interview with California gubernatorial nominee Steve Hilton
beschreibung:
At the GOP midterm convention in Dallas, Donald Trump promises that he'll give every American adult a $5,000 check if — and only if — Republicans retain control of the Senate and House, a plan so absurd that even his own defenders can't explain it.
Jon and Dan process the most ridiculous moments from the 18 hours of speeches, including JD Vance previewing his presidential campaign, Mike Rogers and Ted Cruz using the 25th anniversary of 9/11 to paint Democrats as terrorist sympathizers, and Democratic Senator John Fetterman's surprise video appearance.
Then, to cap off a Republican-filled episode, Lovett talks to Steve Hilton, the Republican nominee for California governor, about his relationship with Trump and what it'll take to tackle California's housing crisis.
